root_cause: External-mutation detection pinned the target file's content-hash before the same step's internal write to that file. Every subsequent check compared against stale content and reported a false drift on every cycle.

details.rule: Pin the content-hash immediately after any internal write to the tracked file, never before it. A pin that straddles a write boundary will always false-positive. If a step both reads and writes the file, pin once at the end of the write, not at the start of the read.
